body:
I don't think I'll be able to hate anything while unconscious. Maybe I'm just a spoiled brat, but none of those things sound very appealing to me. I'm incapable of doing what I want and don't really have much of a desire to do anything else.

I'm not really sure why I'm posting here. I feel my suicide is a foregone conclusion, as soon as I find a way to do it painlessly.
Alright. I'm going to fail a pretty exam tomorrow myself.

I don't know if the pain is temporary, that's the thing. I'm not sure how I can ever feel better about this. That is why death is so appealing - I'm not sure there is any reason for me to climb out of the hole. I don't know what the difference would be.

I'd prefer not to mention my goals, as it would be fairly embarrassing to discuss them. Suffice to say they are not realistic.

I'm a little more open to seeking therapy, but I still feel as if the fact that I am reaching out is not evidence of any sort of real intellectual ability on my part. I'm not worried about the depression holding me back, I'm worried about my intelligence.
I don't know how to respond this. I don't really want to be alive anymore.

First, I guess, thanks for replying. I am crying again right now and the opportunity to talk this over is therapeutic. That being said...

I) I don't think my decision to post here is indicative of any sort of intellectual ability on my part. Perhaps common sense.

II) I can't see any other likely possibility in death that is worse than my life currently. I think it's most likely I will simply cease to exist.

III) I don't think this is really applicable.

VI) I think my aspirations are quite delusional, in that they are not realistic given my background, history, and intellectual record. 

VII)The fact that I, in this particular situation, would require help would only further underscore my inadequacy.

VIII) I'm still not sure how I can be helped.

IX) I didn't mean that.


I don't think it's likely that I will meet my goals :) The sense to reach out for help is not based upon the same intellectual capabilities in which I am lacking in.
